school_name: Columbia University in the City of New York
title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Columbia University
description: Morningside Heights transforms after dark, with students moving from Butler Library to local institutions that have fueled late-night study sessions and post-event gatherings for decades.

cards.title: The On-Campus Late Night Hub
cards.subtitle: John Jay Hall Lower Level
cards.notes: Located in the basement of John Jay Hall, this campus staple serves burgers and comfort food until 10:00 AM daily, making it the primary late-night dining hall for students.
cards.short_summary: JJ's Place is Columbia's official late-night dining destination, offering a casual environment for students to use meal swipes for burgers and snacks well into the morning.
cards.evidence_claim: JJ's Place is open from 12:00 PM to 10:00 AM every day and serves as a late-night destination for burgers and specialty sandwiches.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 10:00 AM. Access requires a Columbia University ID and meal plan swipe or Flex points.

cards.title: The Giant Slice Tradition
cards.subtitle: 2848 Broadway
cards.notes: Famous for its oversized jumbo slices that require two paper plates, this pizzeria stays open until 4:00 AM on weekends to feed the Morningside Heights night crowd.
cards.short_summary: Koronet Pizza is a neighborhood institution known for its massive slices and late-night hours, serving as a reliable stop for students after long library sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Koronet Pizza at 2848 Broadway is open until 4:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays, and until 2:00 AM on other nights.
cards.access_notes: Open until 4:00 AM on Fri-Sat; 2:00 AM Sun-Thu. Counter service with limited indoor seating.

cards.title: The Seinfeld Diner
cards.subtitle: 2880 Broadway
cards.notes: This iconic diner, featured in 'Seinfeld,' offers 24-hour service from Thursday through Sunday morning, providing a classic booth setting for late-night milkshakes and fries.
cards.short_summary: Tom's Restaurant is a historic Morningside Heights diner that serves as a late-night landmark for students, especially during its 24-hour weekend operations.
cards.evidence_claim: Tom's Restaurant is open 24 hours on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, and until 1:30 AM on other nights.
cards.access_notes: 24-hour service available Thursday through Saturday nights. Traditional diner seating.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Grocery Run
cards.subtitle: 2840 Broadway
cards.notes: A 24-hour gourmet grocery store at 110th Street that provides prepared foods, fresh produce, and snacks for students at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: Westside Market is a critical 24-hour resource for Columbia students, offering a wide variety of prepared meals and groceries just south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Westside Market location at 2840 Broadway is open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours every day. Includes a large prepared foods section.

cards.title: The Library Fuel Station
cards.subtitle: Butler Library Lobby
cards.notes: Located inside the main campus library, this café serves coffee and snacks until midnight during the week to support students during long study sessions.
cards.short_summary: Blue Java in Butler Library is the essential on-campus coffee stop for students pulling late nights in the university's primary research library.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Java Butler is open Monday through Thursday until 12:00 AM during the academic term.
cards.source_title: Blue Java Café - Butler Library | Columbia Dining
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Mon-Thu. Requires Columbia ID for library entry.

cards.title: The Late-Night Sweet Tooth
cards.subtitle: 1030 Amsterdam Ave
cards.notes: Specializing in warm cookies delivered until 3:00 AM, this shop is a go-to for students seeking a sugar boost during late-night group projects or social gatherings.
cards.short_summary: Insomnia Cookies provides late-night bakery items and delivery service to the Columbia community, operating well past midnight every day of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies locations typically serve warm cookies until 1:00 AM or 3:00 AM depending on the day.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM on weekends and 1:00 AM on weekdays. Delivery and pickup available.

cards.title: The Gourmet Deli Run
cards.subtitle: 2892 Broadway
cards.notes: A family-owned specialty food shop known for its signature sandwiches and imported goods, serving the campus community until 10:00 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: Milano Market is a popular destination for high-quality sandwiches and deli items, frequently visited by students before the late-night study block begins.
cards.evidence_claim: Milano Market Westside at 2892 Broadway is open 7 days a week from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 10:00 PM. Offers a wide selection of prepared sandwiches and gourmet groceries.

cards.title: The Broadway Slice
cards.subtitle: 2859 Broadway
cards.notes: Located at 111th Street, this pizzeria provides a quick counter-service option for students, with delivery available until 1:00 AM for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: Famous Famiglia is a reliable pizza option on Broadway that stays open late for both pickup and delivery to the Morningside Heights area.
cards.evidence_claim: Famous Famiglia Pizzeria at 2859 Broadway offers pickup until 12:00 AM and delivery until 1:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Open for pickup until midnight and delivery until 1:00 AM daily.

cards.title: The Intellectual Late Night
cards.subtitle: 1030 Amsterdam Ave
cards.notes: A legendary windowless café across from St. John the Divine where students write dissertations over bottomless coffee and strudel until 11:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: The Hungarian Pastry Shop is a historic, Wi-Fi-free haven for writers and students, offering a quiet late-night atmosphere for study and conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hungarian Pastry Shop is open seven days a week until nearly 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: The Upper West Side's Hungarian Pastry Shop Is Open for Everything
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 11:00 PM. Cash only. No Wi-Fi available.

cards.title: The Midnight Study Space
cards.subtitle: John Jay Hall
cards.notes: During peak academic periods, the main John Jay dining area opens as a no-swipe-required study hall until 10:00 PM, providing extra space for late-night work.
cards.short_summary: The John Jay After-Hours Study Hall is a seasonal university initiative that repurposes dining space for late-night student productivity.
cards.evidence_claim: The main seating area of John Jay opens after hours to all Columbia students (no swipe required) as an additional study space until 10:00 PM during designated periods.
cards.source_title: Events - After-Hours Study Hall | Columbia Dining
cards.access_notes: Available during finals and midterms. Open to all Columbia students without a meal swipe.
